disclaimer.title: Terms & disclaimer
disclaimer.body:
This website is a product catalogue. It does not take payments and does not confirm orders.

- Submitting an order request or enquiry is not a purchase and does not guarantee price, availability or delivery.
- The owner will contact you on WhatsApp to confirm availability, the final delivery arrangement and any delivery charge before anything is agreed.
- Prices shown are product-only prices. Courier (Delhivery) charges, if any, are extra and are quoted by the owner after checking your PIN code, parcel weight and current courier rates.
- Pickup from the maker or handover through a friend/known person is only possible where both parties agree; it is arranged directly between you and the owner and is not a service provided by this website.
- Product details, ingredients and storage information are supplied by the owner. If you have an allergy or dietary requirement, please confirm with the owner before ordering.

privacy_notice.title: Privacy notice
privacy_notice.body:
We collect only what we need to respond to your request.

## What we collect
- Your WhatsApp/mobile number.
- Your delivery PIN code and receiving preference (for order requests).
- The products and quantities you selected, and any optional note you add.
- For callback requests: your number, an optional name, preferred contact time and message.

We do not ask for your full address, date of birth, ID documents or payment details on this website, and we do not use advertising or analytics trackers.

## Why we collect it
Only to contact you on WhatsApp or by phone about your request: to confirm availability, delivery options, any delivery charge, payment and handover. We do not sell or share your number for marketing.

## Who can see it
Only the business owner (and our website maintainer when needed to fix a technical problem) through a password-protected admin area. If email notifications are enabled, a copy of the request is emailed to the owner.

## How long we keep it
Requests are reviewed and deleted after about 6 months unless we need them for an ongoing order or a legal/business record.

## Your choices
You can ask us to correct or delete your details at any time by messaging us on WhatsApp or using the contact details on this site. Please mention your request reference if you have it.

products.name: Avakaya Mango Pickle
products.short_description: Classic cut-mango pickle with mustard and red chilli.
products.description: Raw mangoes cut with the stone, mixed with freshly ground mustard, red chilli and salt, then rested in oil. Prepared once a year during mango season.
products.ingredients_text: Raw mango, red chilli powder, mustard powder, salt, gingelly (sesame) oil, fenugreek seeds, garlic.
products.storage_text: Store in a cool, dry place. Always use a clean, dry spoon. Keep the mango pieces covered with oil.
products.shelf_life_text: Best used within 6 months of packing.
products.price_note: Product-only price per pack. Delivery charges, if any, are extra and confirmed on WhatsApp.
